LanguageData.MooGirl_MilkPudding.label: Mugirl milk pudding
LanguageData.MooGirl_MilkPudding.description: Soft like a delicate jelly, rich and quick to melt in the mouth. One serving can linger in a child's memory for days, and many adults love it too.
LanguageData.MooGirl_Cheese.label: Mugirl cheese
LanguageData.MooGirl_Cheese.description: A classic food with a very long shelf life and enough nutrition to fill you up, like an upgraded survival meal.
LanguageData.MooGirl_AgedCheese.label: Aged Mugirl cheese
LanguageData.MooGirl_AgedCheese.description: A fine cheese made with longer fermentation than ordinary cheese. After full fermentation, microorganisms react with Mugirl milk and hops to produce a special amino acid that greatly improves the activity of the liver and other organs, making it a staple for people worried about cardiovascular illness.\n\nRemember to prepare more for elders with family medical histories, especially grandparents. Melted aged cheese is low in sugar, easy to digest, and easy to break down, according to food inspection certification.
